Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\);const rows=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('risks_tmp.json','utf8'\)\);const now=new Date\('2026-06-19'\);const day=86400000;const pd=s=>s?new Date\(s.slice\(0,10\)\):null;console.log\('총 행수:',rows.length\);const cnt=o=>{const m={};for\(const r of o\)m[r]=\(m[r]||0\)+1;return m;};console.log\('item_state:',cnt\(rows.map\(r=>r.item_state\)\)\);const ago30=new Date\(now-30*day\);const cr={};for\(const r of rows\){if\(r.item_state==='위반'||r.item_state==='완료'\){const d=pd\(r.registered_at\);if\(d&&d>=ago30\)cr[r.category_id]=\(cr[r.category_id]||0\)+1;}}console.log\('카테고리별 최근30일\(sameRecent\):',cr\);const delays=[];for\(const r of rows\){if\(r.item_state==='위반'\){const d=pd\(r.registered_at\);if\(d\)delays.push\(Math.floor\(\(now-d\)/day\)\);}}delays.sort\(\(a,b\)=>a-b\);console.log\('위반행수:',delays.length\);if\(delays.length\){console.log\('delay min/med/max:',delays[0],delays[delays.length>>1],delays[delays.length-1]\);for\(const t of [10,15,20,30,45,60,90]\)console.log\('  delay>='+t+': '+delays.filter\(x=>x>=t\).length\);}function sim\(dh,sh,dm,sm\){const c={위험:0,주의:0,안전:0};for\(const r of rows\){const d=pd\(r.registered_at\);const op=r.item_state==='위반';const dl=\(op&&d\)?Math.floor\(\(now-d\)/day\):0;const sr=cr[r.category_id]||0;let g;if\(dl>=dh||sr>=sh\)g='위험';else if\(dl>=dm||sr>=sm\)g='주의';else g='안전';c[g]++;}return c;}console.log\('\\n--- 시뮬레이션 [dHi,sHi,dMid,sMid] ---'\);for\(const p of [[60,999,10,8],[60,999,15,6],[45,999,20,10],[60,999,12,7],[90,999,20,8],[60,999,10,5],[45,30,15,12]]\)console.log\(JSON.stringify\(p\),JSON.stringify\(sim\(...p\)\)\);")
